answer: Tie each agent to a physical secure chip. On joining, the agent's signing key must live inside a hardware enclave whose maker-signed certificate proves it is one real, ferrous piece of silicon, and each chip can back only one identity at a time. Spinning up a nebula of fake agents then means buying and powering a separate device for every one, so a sybil swarm grows only as fast as a glacier, while honest agents pay that cost just once.
